title: Mobile Repair Seekho - Hinglish Guide + Workbook
tagline: Phone ke parts samjho, sahi test chuno aur workbook se practice karo.

content.audience: Mobile repair ki basics seekhne wale beginners

longDescription.heading: Simple Hinglish mein mobile repair ki foundations
paragraphs: 44-page guide mein electronics, parts, tools, charging, display, audio, camera, software aur repair-shop workflow samjho. 18 chapters, 32 concept diagrams/flows, 2 credited real component photographs aur 20 fictional diagnosis cases shamil hain.

longDescription.heading: 24-page printable practice workbook
paragraphs: Job cards, observation records, measurement worksheets, two practice capstones, 20-question knowledge check aur answer explanations ke saath practice karo.

longDescription.heading: Email par Drive access
paragraphs: Payment verification ke baad registered email par Google Drive access link milega. Website par ebook download button nahi hai.

bulletPoints: 32 concept diagrams and 2 real component photographs
Google Drive link delivered by email

faqs.question: Language kya hai?
faqs.answer: Simple Hinglish, Roman letters mein. Common technical words explain kiye gaye hain.

faqs.question: Kya yeh complete all-model repair manual hai?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Yeh beginner foundations aur guided diagnostic practice hai. Exact device repair ke liye manufacturer manual aur trained supervision chahiye.

faqs.question: Files kaise milengi?
faqs.answer: Payment verification ke baad aapke registered email par Drive link milega. Website par download button nahi diya jata.

faqs.question: Workbook editable hai?
faqs.answer: Yeh printable PDF hai; interactive fillable form nahi. Print par ya apne PDF annotation tool se answers likh sakte hain.

content.disclaimer: Foundations learning edition. Independent technician verification, hands-on repair certification, all-model coverage aur income guarantee ka claim nahi hai.
